name: cellA_v1
about: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash cell A on MI355X: DPA4-EP4, bf16 KV, block 128, DSpark 5 drafts at acceptance 3.51, prefix caching (#739 section 1). Take-1 structure (#739 section 3) plus D-multi, the multi-rank decode steps at rungs 24/32 with few group tokens #739 section 8 asks for. kv_tokens: num_kvcache_blocks 277111 x 128 of a_pw_c128/real1/run.json's engine on pit2-p03-g08.

segments.name: D-v1
segments.purpose: each rung's fixed cost at small context

segments.name: D-v2
segments.purpose: row padding at low context: one long anchor among short rows

segments.name: D-v3
segments.purpose: long context at the high rungs

segments.name: D-v3low
segments.purpose: long context at the low rungs: nine anchors leave last

segments.name: D-sym
segments.purpose: every rank busy: the group's MoE tokens at every rung

segments.name: D-multi
segments.purpose: multi-rank decode with a peer's anchor priced below the rung rank 0 holds, at every rung (rule 2.4.3), and few group tokens at rungs 24/32 (#739 section 8)

segments.name: P-quads
segments.purpose: imbalance x density x scale; graph and eager

segments.name: P-backlog
segments.purpose: unbalanced dense prefill: long prompts beside short ones

segments.name: P-trickle
segments.purpose: short prefills and middle chunks on long histories, two sessions a rank

segments.name: P-rows-a
segments.purpose: prefill steps of many rows, every token-graph bucket

segments.name: P-rows-b
segments.purpose: single-row prompts of 8-32k on every rank at once: query_square apart from tokens at output steps
